annotation.title_en: Multinational Parallel Audit on Government Preparedness for Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: State Comptroller and Ombudsman of Israel (EUROSAI parallel audit)
annotation.venue: Office of the State Comptroller of Israel, Special Report
annotation.summary_en: Special report of Israel's State Comptroller presenting a EUROSAI multinational parallel audit of government AI preparedness across 12 countries. It examines strategy, budgets, regulation, infrastructure, security, data governance, projects, human capital and NLP, finding Israel lacks an approved comprehensive national AI plan and shows gaps between budgeting and implementation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Israel has not yet approved a comprehensive long-term national AI strategy with goals, budget and metrics.
Gap between approved budgets and actual execution, especially supercomputing infrastructure.
Data governance and sharing barriers hinder government AI deployment.
Systematic AI literacy and training for public servants is needed.
Risk-adapted regulation and a national AI headquarters (Government Decision 3375) are recommended.
